thread:
maya_h: Proposal: build a small ingress facade for v5->v6 compatibility instead of a full proxy shim. Map only required fields, keep it auditable and fast.
jonathan: What are the main risks?
maya_h: Risks: missed optional semantics, streaming/frame mismatches, accidental passthrough of deprecated fields. Performance: single sync transform at edge, expected <1ms median in perf tests.
lee_arch: Observability? We need mapping telemetry and sampled diffs.
maya_h: Plan: emit compat.event with tags (facade_v1, mapping_id). Record redacted sample diffs under a permissioned store. Add header X-RW-Mapping: <id> for tracing.
sam: How do clients opt-out? SDK changes?
maya_h: Default: facade enabled for v5-shaped traffic for 6 weeks. Clients can send header `X-RW-Compat: legacy-off` to bypass. SDKs will add helpers later but not required.
jonathan: Edge cases: `top_k` -> `candidate_count`, streaming chunk format.
maya_h: Most maps are simple renames. For streaming we add a coercion wrapper to produce legacy chunks when requested.
lee_arch: Rollout checklist?
maya_h: 1) mapping unit tests + property fuzzers, 2) 48h internal shadow traffic, 3) canary 1%->10%->50%, 4) manual approval gates and telemetry review.
jonathan: Escape hatch?
maya_h: Tenant config `compat_mode=proxy` exists. Also auto-disable facade for a tenant for 10m on 5xx spike or token loss and alert #incidents.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging job queued. ENV RW_COMPAT_FACADE=1. Telemetry hooks enabled.
sam: Please include mapping.csv and tools/run_compat_diff.sh in the PR to run golden prompts through both paths and diff outputs.
maya_h: Will attach mapping.csv + run_compat_diff script. Example mapping snippet:
``
v5_param,v6_param,transform
top_k,candidate_count,int
stop_tokens,eos_tokens,list
```
lee_arch: Add a lint rule to block accidental passthrough of deprecated fields.
jonathan: If fuzzing + shadowing look good I'm +1 for canary tomorrow.
maya_h: Opening RFC follow-up PR with checklist and telemetry schema. Ping me to be added as reviewer.
